title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Last summer, Maria went on a trip to the mountains. She took a train from the city early in the morning. The journey was long, but the views from the window were beautiful.

At the end of the day, she reached a small village. She stayed in a little hotel and ate dinner with a family. Maria said it was the best adventure of her life.

questions.text: Where did Maria go last summer?
Who did Maria eat dinner with in the village?
How did Maria probably feel about her trip?
What can we infer about the village?
options: It was very large and crowded
It was located in the city

vocabulary.definition: a trip from one place to another
what you can see from a place
a small community in the countryside

paragraph_translations: El verano pasado, Maria hizo un viaje a las montañas. Tomó un tren desde la ciudad temprano por la mañana. El trayecto fue largo, pero las vistas desde la ventana eran hermosas.
Al final del día, llegó a un pequeño pueblo. Se quedó en un hotelito y cenó con una familia. Maria dijo que fue la mejor aventura de su vida.
